Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks for the note — I’m Redwood’s Head of Security Operations (cc Monica on compliance) and I’ll pick this up. Below are the specifics and what we can share immediately: 

SOC 2:
- We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the 12-month period ending Dec 31, 2025 covering the Security and Availability Trust Services Criteria for the Redwood hosted control environment.
- Attached: redwood-soc2-letter-2025.pdf (standard attestation letter). Full reports are shared under NDA; the letter and test coverage summary are typically sufficient for procurement.

GDPR / HIPAA / Data residency:
- Redwood supports GDPR requirements for hosted customers. For HIPAA/PHI, hosted customers can be supported under a BAA for Dedicated or Private deployments; we do not recommend putting PHI in a multi-tenant hosted environment without a BAA and appropriate contractual controls.

Penetration testing & disclosure policy:
- Pen tests: we complete annual third-party penetration tests (most recent: Oct 2024) and quarterly internal security assessments.
- What we can share immediately: a redacted executive summary and a findings/mitigation table (no raw exploit PoCs or detailed attack steps).
- Full raw reports: available only after an executed NDA and on a strictly limited distribution list (security + legal) due to sensitive exploit details.

Vulnerability management (process & SLAs):
- Scanning cadence: automated unauthenticated scans weekly; authenticated scans monthly; dependency/OSS SCA daily (CI-integrated).
- Remediation SLAs (target): Critical/CVE-9xx+: 72 hours to mitigation/patch or documented compensating controls; High/CVE-7xx–8xx: 7 days; Medium: 30 days; Low: next maintenance window. SLA exceptions are documented and approved by security leadership.
- Patch verification: automated regression tests + vulnerability rescans after remediation to confirm closure.
- Disclosure: coordinated disclosure is our default — we follow a 90-day coordinated disclosure cadence with customers and external researchers for new vulnerabilities, unless immediate mitigation is required. We publish CVE IDs when applicable.

Next steps I can take now:
1) Upload redacted pen-test executive summary + findings table (pen-test-summary-2024-redacted.pdf).
2) Share SOC 2 attestation letter (attached).
3) Join the security deep-dive to walk through any controls mapping and clarify deployment options for HIPAA/BAA.

Alex — for the meeting please let me know whether you want the redacted pen-test summary pre-shared or prefer we walk through it during the call.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Head, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
